instruction: Compare iPhone SE with iPhone 13 mini and iPhone 12 mini

metadata.explanation: Task requires comparing 3 iPhone models (SE and mini versions) on Apple's website. Evaluator checks that the active tab URL contains the modelList parameter with the 3 specified iPhone models (order-independent). Similar complexity to original task, just different model selection focusing on compact models.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts modelList parameter from active tab URL query string using get_active_tab_url_parse
URL parsing handles split_list correctly to convert comma-separated modelList into array
Metric check_direct_json_object correctly compares extracted modelList against expected values
Order-independent comparison is appropriately configured (ignore_list_order: true) since model comparison order doesn't matter
Expected values correctly match the 3 iPhone models specified in instruction: iphone-se, iphone-13-mini, iphone-12-mini
Evaluator properly verifies the semantic requirement: checking that user navigated to Apple comparison page with the correct 3 models
Error handling is appropriate: returns None on parsing failure which fails evaluation as expected
